name: superhuman
description: Connect to Superhuman through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Superhuman hosts an official Mail MCP server (mail and calendar) that needs a Business plan or higher (not Starter) and Ask AI; other MCP clients connect with the URL, and only some Enterprise or managed accounts need their admin to ask Superhuman to enable it. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256, public clients allowed. Superhuman is a mail client over the person's Gmail or Outlook account, so mail and calendar data reach Kipster through Superhuman's cloud; kept because it is the person's own Superhuman account rather than an aggregator, and flagged as a third-party data flow.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
